metadata.description: brief2mp4 and brief2motion: write a brief, get a checked MP4 or live web motion. Skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: brief2mp4
plugins.description: Turn a written brief into a finished, checked MP4 motion graphic in 30 art forms (claymation, paper cut-out, anime, pixel art and more): HyperFrames, Three.js, an optional 3D pack, Blender and ffmpeg. Installs brief2motion too. macOS, Windows, Linux.

plugins.name: brief2motion
plugins.description: Website animation skill: turn a plain brief into a site with professional motion, checked in a real browser. GSAP scroll stories, three.js 3D product pages, kinetic type, page transitions, data stories, particles and 32 visual styles. Installed with brief2mp4.
